donut.description: PieChartCard (Order Type Split): donut innerRadius 65, outerRadius 100, white 1px sector strokes, percent labels with leader lines, coloured legend.

payment-bars.description: BarChartCard (Payment Breakdown drawn as bars): maxBarSize 56, dashed grid, mono 11px ticks with compact currency. The source draws Payment Breakdown as a donut; the bar form is the same BarChartCard used for Peak Sales Distribution and Revenue by Branch.

top-items.description: Top Selling Menu Items: Card padding lg rounded-xl, two-column ranked list with a progress bar (purple-600 to purple-400) per item and a "Ranked Top" badge.

top-items-empty.description: Top Selling Menu Items with no rows: dashed empty box with "No top items data available".

top-items-loading.description: Top Selling Menu Items while loading: centred Spinner (py-12).

loading.description: ChartLoading: h-64 rounded-lg bordered box with a centred Spinner.
